primary.title: India's CPI inflation is 4.38%, but your personal inflation could be higher. Here's how to calculate it
primary.summary: India's CPI inflation stood at 4.38% in June 2026, but your personal inflation rate may differ depending on your spending habits. Using MoSPI's category-wise inflation data, you can calculate your own personal inflation rate.
